source: David (Fresco R&D lead) — verified production knowledge, 2026-06-26
note: Structural entities added to MATRIYA's knowledge model from VERIFIED Fresco production knowledge. These change the model: production starts from material identity, not the formula. Do NOT generalize beyond scope_verified; do NOT fan-out before the ontology reflects these.

entities.definition: Variable that defines raw-material identity (PSD, type, identity). Deviation → reject material.
Variable created during production (pH, viscosity, SG). Deviation → adjust, re-test, release.
Canonical identity of an incoming raw material: PSD, aggregate/cement type, supplier certificate, internal standard.
Production begins at Incoming Material Identity, not at the formula. PASS → production; FAIL → reject material (no formula compensation).
flow: PSD / Material Identity / Certificate / Internal Standard

entities.definition: Quality control of incoming raw materials before production (the entry of the Identity Gate).
Fixed-composition blend prepared in advance; same composition every batch; packed in sealed bags. Has NO separate Batch ID.
Policy mapping a QC failure to an action (Hold Batch vs Adjust→Retest).
Internal particle-size-distribution design. Fresco buys particle fractions separately and designs the PSD in-house — granulometry is a critical variable, not a given.

production_philosophy.principle: Quality is created BEFORE production, not corrected after it.

dry_mortars_qc.cadence: visual inspection every batch; full workability verification ~every 15 batches

production_philosophy.supplier_coa: Supplier CoA is NOT the final authority. Sufficient while no problem; on a failure → event-driven deep investigation: Granulometry → Raw Materials → Supplier.
